title: imap: unit tests for auth handlers, FETCH encoding, and SEARCH criteria
description: Create crates/imap/src/tests/. Unit tests: (1) AUTH=PLAIN: test correct base64 decode, credential check delegation, state transition to Authenticated; test wrong password stays Unauthenticated; test malformed base64 returns BAD; (2) AUTH=LOGIN: test two-step exchange completes; test Cancel aborts; (3) SELECT response: verify all 6 required untagged responses sent in correct order; verify UIDVALIDITY persists across reconnects (same value from DB); (4) FETCH ENVELOPE: given a known OverviewRecord, verify correct Envelope encoding; (5) SEARCH SEEN: verify returns correct seq numbers; SEARCH BEFORE date: verify date comparison logic with known fixtures; (6) EXPUNGE: verify imap_flags rows deleted, correct sequence renumbering. Tests use in-memory SQLite and a MemIpfsStore. Oracle: hand-construct expected IMAP response bytes and compare.
